import { defineTable, col, rel, pgEnum } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { language } from "./language";
import { inventory } from "./inventory";
import { actor } from "./actor";
import { category } from "./category";

const mpaaRatingEnum = pgEnum("mpaa_rating", ["G", "PG", "PG-13", "R", "NC-17"]);

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "length_hours" is a generated column whose expression was not read; it is declared read-only, and a push would plan it as a plain column.
export const film = defineTable("film", {
    columns: {
        filmId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        title: col.text().notNull(),
        description: col.text(),
        releaseYear: col.integer(),
        languageId: col.integer().notNull(),
        originalLanguageId: col.integer(),
        rentalDuration: col.smallint().notNull().default(3),
        rentalRate: col.numeric({ precision: 4, scale: 2 }).notNull().default(4.99),
        length: col.smallint(),
        replacementCost: col.numeric({ precision: 5, scale: 2 }).notNull().default(19.99),
        rating: mpaaRatingEnum().default("G"),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow(),
        specialFeatures: col.text().array(),
        fulltext: col.custom({ dataType: "tsvector" }).notNull(),
        lengthHours: col.numeric({ precision: 4, scale: 2 }).readOnly()
    },
    relations: {
        language: rel.belongsTo(() => language),
        originalLanguage: rel.belongsTo(() => language, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
        inventory: rel.hasMany(() => inventory),
        actor: rel.manyToMany(() => actor, {
            through: "film_actor",
            pivot: {
                lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
            }
        }),
        category: rel.manyToMany(() => category, {
            through: "film_category",
            pivot: {
                lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
            }
        })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
